title: Branches and the Rule on Main
objective: Commit the README on main, switch to a feature branch, commit a change, and print the branch name.
hint: Commit the README on main with git init -q -b main, then git switch -q -c feature/hosted-review. Add-Content the Hosted review note line, git add, git commit -q -m Add hosted review note. Then Write-Output (git branch --show-current).
